name: wlthy
title: Wlthy
description: See your net worth, day and month change, and allocation from your wlthy wealth account — read-only, without leaving your keyboard.
author: alirbaba

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: wlthy API key
preferences.description: A read-only REST key you create in wlthy → Settings → API & MCP. Starts with wlthy_rest_. It can only read your ledger — it cannot move money or change anything.

preferences.name: instanceUrl
preferences.title: wlthy URL
preferences.description: Only change this for a white-label / self-hosted wlthy instance. Leave as-is for the standard app.

commands.name: net-worth
commands.title: Net Worth
commands.description: Show your total net worth with today's and this month's change.

commands.name: allocation
commands.title: Allocation
commands.description: Break your wealth down by asset class, currency, geography or sector.

commands.name: by-country
commands.title: By Country
commands.description: See your net worth by country, with leverage (assets vs debt) per country.

commands.name: assets
commands.title: Assets
commands.description: Search every holding, sorted by value.

commands.name: debts
commands.title: Debts
commands.description: See what you owe, sorted by balance.

commands.name: net-worth-menu-bar
commands.title: Net Worth in Menu Bar
commands.description: Keep your net worth glanceable in the macOS menu bar. Refreshes hourly.
